packages.title: Credit Packs
packages.headline: Buy prepaid credits for AI music generation and audio processing. One-time purchase. No subscription or automatic renewal.
packages.explanation: Credits are used for paid AI operations such as music generation, creating a Personal AI Voice, stem separation, and other AI tools. Manual Music Editor actions, reuse of an existing Personal AI Voice, and MP3/WAV export do not consume credits.
packages.gelPaymentNote: Payment is processed in GEL. The GEL equivalent is calculated from the current official USD/GEL exchange rate of the National Bank of Georgia. The exact GEL amount is fixed when you proceed to checkout and is shown before you confirm payment.
packages.examplesDisclaimer: Generation estimates are examples, not guarantees. Actual credit usage depends on the AI operations you choose.
packages.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
packages.checkoutRedirectInvalid: Payment page is unavailable. Please try again.
